storyCards.headline: Praise You: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Fatboy Slim's "Praise You" reached #36 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #36 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Praise You was released in 1998.

Album: You've Come A Long Way, Baby (1998).
